name: Doctor Gregory Victor
summary: At Hammerfall, Doctor Gregory Victor tends the Horde’s wounded and trains medics for the fighting in the Arathi Highlands. Renowned as its premier trauma physician, he teaches advanced triage and battlefield first aid.

sections.title: Surgeon of Hammerfall
sections.body: Doctor Gregory Victor treats the Horde’s wounded at Hammerfall, in the contested Arathi Highlands. Though many distrust Forsaken apothecaries, he uses surgery instead of blighted alchemy on soldiers hurt by Syndicate brigands, Boulderfist ogres, and Alliance forces. Hammerfall is the Horde’s main proving ground for field medics, and Victor demands speed and care when the most critical patients are under pressure.

faq.answer: Doctor Gregory Victor is a Forsaken physician at Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and the Horde’s premier trauma surgeon. He oversees triage and trains advanced field medics.

faq.q: Where can I find Doctor Gregory Victor?
faq.answer: You can find Doctor Gregory Victor inside Hammerfall, in northeastern Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What role does he play for the Horde?
faq.answer: Doctor Victor tests promising field medics in battlefield triage. He teaches them to stabilize the dying and make advanced cloth bandages for frontline combat.
Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen is the Alliance counterpart. He oversees advanced trauma and triage training at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can look to Doctor Victor for battlefield medicine at a precarious outpost. He helps warriors on the Arathi front return to fighting shape.
As an undead, you can see Doctor Victor’s work as proof that the Forsaken can master mortal anatomy and restorative surgery, apart from the Royal Apothecary Society’s toxic concoctions.
